cognitive_efficiency.notes: 9-module grid creates moderate choice overload. Clear hierarchy with PageHeader + hero + metrics + modules. 30s polling keeps data fresh without user action. Progressive disclosure via WidgetBoundary (collapsed by default).

motor_efficiency.notes: All stat cards and module cards are full-width links (large tap targets). 44px+ effective area per card. Icon+text labels aid recognition. ArrowRight indicators signal interactivity.

visual_hierarchy.notes: Clear F-pattern: hero → metrics → modules → widgets. text-2xl for KPI values, text-xs for labels. Consistent rounded-xl cards with border-border. Emerald accent used consistently for positive states.

feedback_responsiveness.notes: Loading state ('Loading overview…') and error state (rose border + message) handled. 30s auto-polling with onRefresh button. No skeleton loaders — full-card placeholders instead.

consistency_familiarity.notes: Consistent card pattern across stat and module cards. Same hover behavior (emerald border + translate-x arrow). iconMap is clean. Minor: text-[11px] used in 2 places (non-standard spacing). transition-all on card links is a known AI-slop tell.

accessibility_snapshot.contrast: PASS — text-text-muted (#94a3b8) on bg-bg-surface (#0f172a) = 4.5:1 (AA met for large text, borderline for small)
accessibility_snapshot.keyboard: PASS — all interactive elements are <Link> with focus rings from global styles
accessibility_snapshot.focus: PASS — native focus outlines preserved (no outline:none found)
accessibility_snapshot.targets: PASS — card links are full-width (well above 44px minimum)
accessibility_snapshot.aria: MINOR — stat cards have no aria-label for screen readers (icon-only context lost); module cards same
accessibility_snapshot.error_handling: PASS — error state shows user-readable message in rose-bordered box

findings.issue: 9 equal-weight module cards compete for attention. No visual differentiation between high-frequency (Gates, Alerts) and low-frequency (Reports, Occupancy) modules.
findings.fix: Add a 'Frequently Used' section with top-3 modules; move the rest to a 'More' expander.

findings.issue: Full-card placeholder ('Loading overview…') gives no indication of progress. User may think the page is broken.
findings.fix: Add a skeleton shimmer or progress indicator to the metrics section.

findings.issue: Icon-only context (Shield, Users, etc.) is not announced to screen readers. aria-label is missing on card links.
findings.fix: Add aria-label={`Gates Online: ${activeGates} of ${totalGates}`} to each stat card.

findings.issue: text-[11px] is an arbitrary value that doesn't map to the standard scale. Used in audit events timestamp and info strip.
findings.fix: Replace with text-xs (12px) — already in use elsewhere on the page.

findings.issue: Amber warning strip at bottom uses a distinct color from the emerald action cards — appropriately differentiates warning from action.
Full-width card links provide large tap targets. ArrowRight indicators make the affordance clear.

quick_wins.fix: Replace text-[11px] with text-xs in audit events + info strip
quick_wins.impact: High — removes arbitrary values, improves readability

quick_wins.fix: Add aria-label to stat card and module card links
quick_wins.impact: High — screen reader users can understand card context

quick_wins.fix: Add skeleton loader or spinner to the 'Loading overview…' state
quick_wins.impact: Medium — prevents 'is the page broken?' confusion

actionable_improvements.change: Segment modules into 'Frequently Used' (top 3) and 'All Modules' (expandable)
actionable_improvements.impact: Reduces Hick's Law overload from 9 → 3 primary choices

actionable_improvements.change: Replace transition-all on card links with specific transition properties (border-color, background-color, transform)
actionable_improvements.impact: Performance + removes AI-slop tell (transition-all is a known unslop pattern)
